wiki.title: Gary Clemons
wiki.extract: Gary Dale Clemons (born August 6, 1974) is an American politician from Kentucky who is a member of the Kentucky Senate from the 37th district. Clemons was elected in a December 2025 special election following the resignation of incumbent senator David Yates, who left the position in October of that year to become Jefferson County Clerk.
